en.name: Gravity Slingshot
en.description: Gravity Slingshot: Grand Tour. Fly a probe through up to four gravity assists across eight worlds, from a Comet and ringed Saturn to a Red giant, a Pulsar and a Black hole, with fresh VRF randomness every leg. Bank your tour value between assists or burn onward, up to 952.32x; every route pays 93% RTP.
